verdict.rationale: RUN documents its own export of journal entries to accounting tools or "a generic output file", and lets admins view, customize and print reports. That is a narrow, accounting-focused slice of the story, not a full data export. API Central is a developer building block for integrations and earns no credit toward a self-service export-and-leave capability. Missing for 10: a documented complete export of all account data (employees, pay history, tax filings, HR records), explicitly named open formats (CSV/JSON), a documented offboarding or account-closure data-portability path, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Export journal entries from ADP into QuickBooks®, Xero, Wave, Creative Solutions or a generic output file without re-keying data.
View, access, customize and print payroll and HR reports online.
